title: Do not postpone remembrance
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 35
summary: The shabad starts by exposing the delaying mind that keeps waiting for the right time to remember the Lord. It responds with day-and-night attunement and devotion that does not forget the Beloved even briefly.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who respects practice in principle but keeps scheduling it out of reach. Taken steadily, it breaks procrastination's spell and teaches constancy more than intensity.
takeaway: Remembrance becomes true when it stops waiting for later.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je velaa vakhat veechaareeaai taa kit velaa bhagat hoi ||
lines.translation: If we keep contemplating about the time as to when to remember the Lord, then when will we find the actual time for worship?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin naame ratiaa sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eik til piaaraa visarai bhagat kinehee hoi ||
lines.translation: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal saach siau saas na birathaa koi ||1||
lines.translation: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har kaa naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat taa theeaai jaa har vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje khetee raaheeaai sach naam beej pai ||
lines.translation: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khetee ja(n)mee agalee manooaa rajaa sahaj subhai ||
lines.translation: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mrit hai jit peetai tikh jai ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: eih man saachaa sach rataa sache rahiaa samai ||2||
lines.translation: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan vekhan bolanaa sabadhe rahiaa samai ||
lines.translation: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sunai ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa reh giaa sachai liaa milai ||
lines.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin kau mahal hadhoor hai jo sach rahe liv lai ||3||
lines.translation: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadharee naam dhiaaieeaai vin karamaa paiaa na jai ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag satasa(n)gat lahai satagur bheTai jis aai ||
lines.translation: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin naame ratiaa dhukh bikhiaa vichahu jai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabadh milaavaRaa naame naam samai ||4||22||55||
lines.translation: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

structure: The shabad begins by mocking the mind's endless search for a more convenient hour.
From there it insists on day-and-night attunement as the real measure of devotion.
The closing movement rests by showing that even brief forgetfulness exposes a heart still learning constancy.
